comunicats.submitText1: If you are part of a local association, group or organisation and want to announce an activity, event or information of public interest, you can send us your announcement by email.
comunicats.submitText2: Announcements will be reviewed before publication. GUIAPINEDA reserves the right not to publish offensive, defamatory or inappropriate content.

fotoMes.label: Photo of the month
fotoMes.modalTitle: Participate in the Photo of the month
fotoMes.modalIntro: You can send your photographs of Pineda de Mar to participate in the GUIAPINEDA Photo of the month section.
fotoMes.rule1: Photographs must be taken in Pineda de Mar.
fotoMes.rule2: Horizontal format and good quality are recommended.
fotoMes.rule4: Do not send close-up photos of minors or people without permission.
fotoMes.rule5: GUIAPINEDA reserves the right of selection and publication.
fotoMes.pageIntro: Send your photograph of Pineda de Mar to participate in GUIAPINEDA’s Photo of the month.
fotoMes.formPhotoHelp: Allowed formats: JPG, PNG or WEBP. Recommended maximum: 5 MB.
fotoMes.formAccept: I confirm that I am the author of the photograph and accept that GUIAPINEDA may review it and publish it if selected.
fotoMes.homeIntro: Share your view of Pineda de Mar. Each month we select a photograph that highlights the places, moments and people that make the town special.

about.metaDescription: Discover what GUIAPINEDA is, why it exists and the goals of this local digital platform for Pineda de Mar.
about.heroTitle: A digital platform for Pineda de Mar
about.heroLead: Local information, resources and participation in one place.
about.introText1: GUIAPINEDA was created with a simple idea: to bring together useful information, resources and tools for people who live, work in or visit Pineda de Mar.
about.introText2: The project aims to make it easier to access businesses, services, organisations, local resources, useful information and opportunities for community participation through a clear and accessible website designed specifically for the town.
about.pillarUsefulText: Make it easier to access businesses, services, organisations, resources and places of interest around the town.
about.pillarVisibilityText: Create a space where initiatives, businesses and organisations in Pineda can be discovered more easily.
about.pillarParticipationText: Open channels for residents and organisations to share information, proposals, improvements and content related to Pineda de Mar.
about.pillarLocalText: Build a platform focused specifically on the town, its neighbourhoods, its activity and its community.
about.participationTitle: A website that grows through participation
about.participationText: GUIAPINEDA is designed as an evolving platform. Part of its growth also depends on the participation of businesses, organisations and local people.
about.participationComunicatsText: Local information shared by organisations, groups, businesses and people from the town.
about.participationMilloremText: A space to share local issues, civic concerns and constructive proposals.
about.participationFotoText: A collective view of the places, moments and people that are part of Pineda de Mar.
about.principlesTitle: How we want to build GUIAPINEDA
about.principleUtilityText: Information should be useful and easy to find.
about.principleProximityText: Pineda de Mar and the community that lives, works and participates here are at the centre of the project.
about.principleClarityText: An experience that is simple to use, understandable and accessible.
about.principleParticipationText: Create ways for residents, organisations and businesses to contribute to the content.
about.principleEvolutionText: GUIAPINEDA is not conceived as a finished website, but as a project that can grow and improve over time.
about.futureText: The aim is for GUIAPINEDA to progressively become a digital reference point for finding information, discovering what Pineda offers and taking part in local life.
about.closing: To build a useful website for Pineda and for the people who are part of it.
